text:
matt: Heads up — saw p99 jump ~9% on Llama3-13B after switching rope defaults + SiLU build into the release image. Repro on staging with chatpad workload.
jia: ugh. which change exactly? rope theta or kernel selector?
matt: rope_theta lowered from 0.9->0.6 in the release profile, and we enabled fused SiLU path for RMSNorm models. Kernel selector flipped to fused_gemm_v2 on a subset of head_dim configs.
sam: can you paste the perf numbers / trace?
matt: baseline p99 = 42ms, after change = 46ms. tail tokens spiked on warm caches. nsight trace shows frequent kernel rebinds + small dispatches. snippet: ```# warmup trace sampling
kernel_name: fused_gemm_v2
dispatches: 124k
avg_launch_us: 3.2
kv_hit_ratio: 0.72
```
nisha: kv_hit_ratio 0.72 seems low for chatpad (expected >0.9). are we prefetching prefixes?
matt: chatpad uses prefix-preserve + dynamic padding. The adaptive batcher sliced a lot of short chats into many small groups which prevented KV coalescing.
perf-bot: @matt opened perf/regress/4123456789 with attached nsys.
jia: hypothesis: fused_gemm_v2 has worse latency for head_dim=64 case when batch sizes are <8 due to extra kernel launch overhead. plus SiLU path adds elementwise kernel.
sam: can we force kernel selector -> legacy_gemm for head_dim=64 and rerun? Also try disabling siLU fused path as an A/B.
matt: already ran quick A/B: forcing legacy_gemm brought p99 back to 42-43ms. Disabling fused SiLU also restored ~3ms. Combining both gets baseline.
nisha: sounds like two small regressions compounding: rope_theta change increased activation norm leading to different execution path? or more prefix divergence causing smaller batches?
matt: rope change increased positional phase mixing — we saw more KV key churn in the first 5 tokens which reduces prefix reuse. That + smaller batch groups = more kernel switches.
perf-bot: recommended next steps: 1) add head_dim->preferred_kernel override for head_dim<=64, 2) revert siLU fused by default behind feature flag, 3) increase adaptive-batcher min_coalesce_tokens to 48.
sam: agree. also add microbench for SiLU elementwise with aligned memory. maybe vectorize.
jia: I'll prot a patch for kernel override and batcher tuning. nisha help with rope_theta rollback experiment?
nisha: on it. I'll run a matrix: rope_theta {0.6,0.8,0.95} x head_dim {32,64,128} x batch_size {4,8,16} and share flamegraphs.
matt: thanks. one more thing — chat template now injects a system prefix (~32 tokens) which we didn't account for in the prefetch window. might be skewing batcher heuristics. Can we normalize chatpad templates for the test?
sam: yes, ignore system prefix in coalescing logic for the experiment.
perf-bot: scheduled a canary with kernel override + batcher change for next deploy slot. infra-bot: canary will run on pool-gpu-c, 3 pods, 2h window.
jia: will follow up with PR + benchmark results in this thread. :thumbsup:
